name: mc_blueprint
title: Blueprints
description:
Stores reusable project blueprints with named components, palettes and repeated instances. save/get/list/delete operate on plugin-owned JSON documents, not world blocks.

WHEN TO USE: reusable windows, columns, towers or rooms; preserving an overall design across calls or agent sessions. Save once, then build with mc_build({blueprint:{id:...},transform:{origin:[x,y,z],...}}). Components use the same fills/blocks/text entries and block orientation rules as mc_build.
WHEN NOT TO USE: terrain inspection, block placement or previews. Use mc_build to place a saved blueprint.

PARAMETERS: action save/get/list/delete; id is 1-64 lowercase characters (letter first, then letters/digits/_/-). save requires a version-1 document and explicit overwrite:true to replace an existing ID. A document contains named flat components and ordered instances with local pos, optional rotation/mirror and repeat:{count,step}. Repetition step is in the project frame. Components can use $role or $role[property=value] for materials; inline properties override palette properties. Precedence: component defaults < document palette < mc_build blueprint.palette < instance palette. Sign strings and lettering content are not substituted. dimensions and constraints are advisory metadata, not enforced design rules. Nested components are not supported in version 1.

SIDE EFFECTS: save/delete modify persistent blueprint files only; no world changes. get/list are read-only. Maximum 256 documents, 2 MiB per document, 128 components, 10,000 raw operations and 4,096 expanded instances. Saving validates structure, not native block states or all role bindings; mc_build validates compiled states before any writes and applies server build limits. Deleting a blueprint never removes already-built structures.

overwrite.description: save only. Default false; explicit true permits replacement.

document.description: save only. Flat components, with local coordinates. Dimensions and constraints are retained as metadata.

constraints.description: Optional advisory project requirements. Preserved verbatim; not enforced yet.

palette.description: Role name -> literal block state. No recursive $role bindings.

components.description: Names follow the same format as id. Each component has raw mc_build operations and optional material defaults. No nested instances.

block.description: Literal block state or $role, optionally with [properties] to override palette properties.

filter.description: Partial block-state filter, including optional $role. Omitted properties remain wildcards.

block.description: Literal block state or $role[property=value]. Orientation rules are the same as mc_build; supply both door/bed halves.

component.description: Name of a component in this document.
